name: ok_session_archived
description: session/archived, the record that says a session starts no new work. H5 added it so a subagent may not be started (or resumed) under an archived session, which is what DSH's archive-admission listener does. The record carries an optional `reason` and nothing else: an archived session is a fact in its own log, not a flag on a process, so a later process reaches the same conclusion.

payload.reason: the operator finished with this branch of work
the operator finished with this branch of work
